notes: Polyneum (src/Polyneum.sol) is a plain OpenZeppelin v5.1.0 ERC20 with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 POLYNEUM (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) once to msg.sender, which in the launch is the ProjectFactory; the factory then pays the supply out (the swarm's share to the launch's MerkleDistributor, 88% to seed the pool, the remaining 2% to economics.remainderTo). The token has no owner, no admin role, no mint, burn or burnFrom, no pause, blacklist, freeze or seize, no fee, tax or burn on transfer, no upgradeability and no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT in its runtime, so every launch flow moves exactly what it says and the supply can never grow. There are no application contracts: the accepted tree contains only the token, a local forge deployment script (not used by the launch) and tests. The pool pairs with IMD (0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7) on Ethereum at the launch policy's 1.25% fee and tick spacing 60; pool.initialPrice is provenance only, since the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the supply.
